method: rotating drum, 16 mm diameter, 2.55 mm periodic slice, 20 rpm (Froude 0.0036)
notes: Angle = slope of a line fitted to the top of the bed over the central 60 % of the drum width, per 0.02 s dump, averaged over the window. Rough wall: frozen 0.3 mm spheres rotated with fix move rotate. Cohesive run: major avalanches from 62.0 deg (t=0.59 s) to 25.3 deg (0.71 s) and from 53.6 deg (1.07 s) into a slump at 1.11-1.19 s; fitted angles of 13-22 deg during the slump are artifacts (surface not straight). Local extrema lists include small wiggles.
